# p0_1password_connector_staged (Resource)

A staged 1Password connector installation. Staging tells P0 where the connector will run, and names the identity it must run as.

Use `hosting` and the read-only `connector_identity` to deploy P0's 1Password connector: a Lambda function and its IAM role on AWS, or a Cloud Run service and its service account on Google Cloud. Once the connector is deployed, create a `p0_1password_connector` resource with the same `id` and `hosting` to complete the installation.

Where a connector runs can't change once it is added, so changing `id` or `hosting` replaces the connector. If the connector is already added in P0, import it rather than creating it: P0 refuses to add a connector twice.

**Prerequisite:** P0 invokes the connector as its own identity in your cloud. For AWS Lambda, `p0_aws_iam_write` must be installed for the account the connector runs in. For Google Cloud Run, `p0_gcp` must be installed.

**Note:** This integration is currently in beta.

For the full install steps, see [1Password](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/resource-integrations/1password).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Staging tells P0 where the connector will run, and names the identity it must
# run as (connector_identity). Requires p0_aws_iam_write for the account. See
# the p0_1password_connector example for the full chain.
resource "p0_1password_connector_staged" "example" {
  id = "prod"

  hosting = {
    type             = "aws"
    account_id       = p0_aws_iam_write.example.id
    connector_name   = "p0-1password-prod"
    connector_region = "us-west-2"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting` (Attributes) Where the connector runs. The connector's Terraform deploys it there, and P0 invokes it there. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosting))
- `id` (String) A name you choose for the connector, such as `prod`. Each account picks its connector by it. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit, up to 63 characters.

### Read-Only

- `connector_identity` (Attributes) The identity the connector must run as: an IAM role on AWS, or a service account on Google Cloud, named after the connector. P0 doesn't look the identity up, so deploy the connector with exactly this one. Each account that names the connector lets this identity read its service account token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connector_identity))
- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed

<a id="nestedatt--hosting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosting`

Required:

- `connector_name` (String) The name of the Lambda function or Cloud Run service hosting the connector
- `connector_region` (String) The region the connector is deployed in (e.g. `us-east-1` on AWS, or `us-central1` on Google Cloud)
- `type` (String) The connector's hosting: either `aws` (Lambda) or `gcp` (Cloud Run)

Optional:

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID in which the connector's Lambda function is deployed. Required for, and only valid with, `aws` hosting.
- `project_id` (String) The Google Cloud project ID in which the connector's Cloud Run service is deployed. Required for, and only valid with, `gcp` hosting.


<a id="nestedatt--connector_identity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connector_identity`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) The ID of the AWS account the role is in. Only populated for `aws`.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Google Cloud project the service account is in. Only populated for `gcp`.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role the connector's Lambda function runs as. Only populated for `aws`.
- `role_name` (String) The name of the IAM role the connector's Lambda function runs as. Only populated for `aws`.
- `service_account_email` (String) The email of the service account the connector's Cloud Run service runs as. Only populated for `gcp`.
- `service_account_id` (String) The account ID of the service account the connector's Cloud Run service runs as: the part of its email before the `@`. Only populated for `gcp`.
- `type` (String) The identity's cloud: either `aws` (an IAM role) or `gcp` (a service account)
